title: Numbers 11–20 and Weather
label: ch:ka-numbers-and-weather
canDo: I can say what the weather is doing in Kannada and count past ten up to twenty.

payoff.summary: Count 11 and 12 as ten-plus-a-digit and say what is buried in ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು, then say ಹವಾಮಾನ — the Persian hava plus Sanskrit māna — and report the weather with ಮಳೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ, "rain is coming."
payoff.note: KA-C20-havamana assesses four of the chapter's six atoms: both number atoms (KA-C20-hannondu-ippattu, now a prerequisite) and both weather atoms. The anchor word ಝರಿ (KA-C20-jhari, 491) and the letter ಝ (KA-S128-letter-jha, 492) are taught after the payoff and are not assessed.
